text.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ

words.gloss_range: exception particle scoping backward to the prior returned-state verdict and forward to the qualified group
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) makes 95:6 begin inside the ruling of 95:5 rather than as a fresh detached sentence. It reaches back to the descent verdict, excludes the following group from that judgment, and turns the ayah into a hinge from general return-down to named exemption. The structure then moves from exception marker to qualifying relative clause to result, so the reward is parsed as the consequence of a defined exception rather than as a loose contrast.

topics.headline: exception scoped to the prior verdict
topics.summary: The particle depends on 95:5 and removes the following class from that prior judgment.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader carries the prior descent verdict into 95:6 before hearing who is exempted from it.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both mark the word as an exception particle whose scope is the preceding returned-state judgment.

topics.headline: exception-to-result architecture
topics.summary: The ayah progresses from exception, to qualification, to consequence, without requiring literal courtroom imagery.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a structured criterion: exemption is defined before reward is declared.
topics.reason: The local syntax licenses the legal-like sequence, but the stronger courtroom label is kept as structural metaphor rather than a literal setting.

topics.headline: boundary reversal from descent
topics.summary: The exception reverses the downward movement of 95:5 for the qualified class.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the first word of 95:6 as the turn away from the prior low-state outcome.
topics.reason: The exception is explicitly tied to the previous ayah, so the semantic bridge from degradation to exemption is locally coherent.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun forming the excepted group and heading its qualifying clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) supplies the people named by the exception. Because it is a definite relative pronoun, the text does not introduce an undefined crowd; it creates an identifiable class through the actions that follow. The word therefore converts the prior general human verdict into a subgroup question: which humans are excepted, and by what defining predicates? Its familiar faith-and-action formula gives the clause a recognizable Quranic profile while the local syntax keeps it in the role of the excepted term.

topics.headline: definite excepted class
topics.summary: The relative pronoun fills the excepted role and creates a defined group through the following clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the exemption populated by a defined class, not by an unnamed exception.
topics.reason: The word is the visible excepted term after the exception particle and heads the qualifying relative clause.

topics.headline: membership defined before reward
topics.summary: The relative clause defines the group through faith and action before the reward clause appears.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reward waits until the exempt group has been syntactically qualified.
topics.reason: The clause chain is exception, relative qualification, then result, so the pronoun initiates the condition-bearing portion.

topics.headline: formulaic faith-action subgroup
topics.summary: The relative pronoun opens a recurrent faith-and-action formula while extracting a subgroup from the prior human referent.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a familiar Quranic class formula functioning locally as the exception to humanity's prior verdict.
topics.reason: The supplied recurrence evidence supports formulaic pressure, and the pronoun's local role keeps that formula tied to the exception.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural faith/trust verb used without an expressed object in the defining relative clause
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes security, trust, belief, safe-conduct, and trustworthiness; locally the objectless Form IV faith/trust sense is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) is the first predicate defining the exempt group. Its perfect plural ending ties it back to the relative head, and the completed aspect matches the later action verb. The verb appears without a named object, so the clause emphasizes an entered state of trust and security rather than a locally specified proposition alone. That open trust-state is not left isolated: the recurrent faith-and-action pairing binds it to the work that follows. Its initial hamza and long vowel give the qualifying clause an audible catch and release before the second predicate arrives. Within the surah, the same security root also recalls the earlier secure land in 95:3, so the exempt group is heard inside the surah's safety register.

topics.headline: objectless entered trust-state
topics.summary: The Form IV verb lacks an expressed object, preserving trust/security pressure without forcing an unspecified object into the line.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices faith as an open, self-involving state of trust rather than only a transitive belief claim with a missing object supplied.
topics.reason: The local frame is objectless Form IV; causative and security language is retained as lexical pressure but narrowed away from an overexplicit etymological paraphrase.

topics.headline: plural perfect class predicate
topics.summary: The verb's perfect plural agreement makes it the first completed predicate of the relative class.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees trust grammatically attached to the exempt class as a completed defining predicate.
topics.reason: The 3mp agreement is syntactically controlled by the relative head, and the perfect aspect parallels the second verb.

topics.headline: faith bound to action
topics.summary: The verb enters a high-frequency faith-plus-action formula rather than standing as the only criterion.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears trust immediately leaning toward enacted work as the paired condition for exemption.
topics.reason: Coordination evidence and recurrence evidence both support the faith-action pairing as a meaningful local formula.

topics.headline: faith-action-reward cluster
topics.summary: The faith verb participates in the broader formula that includes sound action and reward.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first predicate already belongs to the reward-bearing formula completed later in the ayah.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence profile links the roots of faith, work, soundness, and recompense in this local construction.

topics.headline: security echo with 95:3
topics.summary: The faith verb echoes the earlier security adjective of the secure land.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the exempt group's trust in 95:6 resonate with the surah's earlier security language in 95:3.
topics.reason: The same root family appears in 95:3 and 95:6, and the local Form IV keeps the echo semantic rather than making the earlier title control the verb.

topics.headline: audible entry into qualification
topics.summary: The initial hamza and long vowel mark the onset of the first defining predicate.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the qualifying clause begin with a distinct catch and release before the second predicate arrives.
topics.reason: The sound observation is locally tied to the first verb's position and does not claim independent semantic proof.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction binding the work predicate to the faith predicate under the same relative head
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the exemption criterion compound. It joins the action verb to the faith verb under the same relative subject, so the line does not present trust and work as separate identities or sequential afterthoughts. As a bound onset on the second predicate, it also makes the movement from inner trust to enacted work quick and syntactically fused.

topics.headline: compound faith-work condition
topics.summary: The conjunction coordinates the two predicates as one qualification of the excepted group.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears faith and action as joined criteria for exemption rather than alternatives.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses coordination between the two verbs inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: fused hinge to enacted work
topics.summary: The bound conjunction visibly and audibly attaches to the second predicate while shifting the clause from trust to work.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action enters as the immediate joined continuation of trust.
topics.reason: The conjunction is a proclitic on the second verb and marks the local pivot between the two predicates.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect plural action/work verb with an explicit object, coordinated with the objectless faith verb
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes doing, labor, practice, operation, manufacture, and productive work; locally it selects direct enacted work completed by the sound-deeds object
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) gives the second predicate of the exempt group. Like the faith verb, it is perfect plural and returns to the relative head, but unlike the faith verb it immediately takes the definite sound-deeds noun as its object. That contrast matters: faith is left objectless and open, while action is directed toward a known class of sound deeds. The plain Form I and the root's work field make the condition concrete as productive doing, and its formulaic pairing with sound deeds and reward places the action upstream of recompense. In recitation, the phrase moves from a guttural onset toward the open vowels of the object, so the sound also carries the movement from doing into the deed category.

topics.headline: parallel completed action predicate
topics.summary: The perfect plural verb shares the subject and aspect of the faith verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees work as co-defining the same exempt group, not as a later comment.
topics.reason: The verb is coordinated with the first predicate and its plural suffix is controlled by the same relative head.

topics.headline: directed work after objectless faith
topics.summary: The action verb takes the sound-deeds object, contrasting with the previous objectless faith verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action is not left abstract; it is completed by a recognizable object.
topics.reason: The attachment layer marks the following noun as the syntactically forced direct object of the verb.

topics.headline: productive direct doing
topics.summary: The root and Form I frame the predicate as direct enacted work, while avoiding an overclaim that only production language can translate it.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the condition as concrete work that produces sound outcomes, not generic moral motion.
topics.reason: The work/labor branch is coherent for the local verb, but the phrasing is narrowed to lexical pressure rather than excluding normal action renderings.

topics.headline: work linked to sound deeds and reward
topics.summary: The verb participates in the recurrent work-soundness-reward formula.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this action as structurally upstream of the reward clause rather than as an isolated virtue word.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence evidence links this root with sound deeds and reward in the local formulaic field.

topics.headline: created form answered by action
topics.summary: The action clause can be read as answering the created-best-form frame of 95:4, but only as a surah-level bridge.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect the work of 95:6 with the human form named in 95:4 as realization, not as a repeated root claim.
topics.reason: The bridge is thematic across the surah rather than a local root repetition, so it is preserved with that limit.

topics.headline: sound opens toward the object
topics.summary: The recited phrase moves from the verb's guttural onset toward the open vowels of the object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the clause move from doing into the named category of sound deeds.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the local verb-object phrase and kept supportive rather than probative.

topics.headline: plain form, object, and formula converge
topics.summary: Morphology, transitivity, and formulaic pairing converge to make the action condition concrete.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a stack of signals making action direct, object-bearing, and recognizable.
topics.reason: The row accurately summarizes multiple locally licensed signals already preserved in the word's topics.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine plural active participle used substantively as the direct object: the known sound or fitting deeds
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes soundness, rightness, repair, proper order, and functional fitness; locally it names the known class of sound acts
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) completes the action verb as its direct object. Its definiteness and feminine plural form make the object a known class of acts, not merely a manner of acting. The assimilated definite article tightens that known category audibly and visibly into one noun. The root's soundness and repair field keeps the phrase from flattening into a vague moral label: these are deeds that are fitting, restorative, and recognizable. Placed just before the result particle, the word closes the qualification before the result clause begins. Across the surah boundary, that soundness field answers the low-state language of 95:5 and leads toward the judgment/recompense question of 95:7.

topics.headline: known object of the work verb
topics.summary: The noun is governed as the direct object of the preceding action verb and marked as a definite plural category.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the work condition completed by a known deed-category rather than left as generic activity.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the noun as the explicit direct object, and QAC marks it as definite feminine plural.

topics.headline: soundness and repair, not vague piety
topics.summary: The root field frames the deeds as sound, fitting, and restorative while remaining within the conventional righteous-deeds phrase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears righteousness as functional soundness and repair, not only as an abstract moral label.
topics.reason: The ṣ-l-ḥ branch supports soundness and fitness, but the local substantive plural keeps the phrase in the deed-category sense.

topics.headline: audibly definite category
topics.summary: The assimilated definite article fuses with the noun, making the known deed class sound tightly bound.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the familiar deed category enter as a single definite unit.
topics.reason: The form observation is local and supports the definiteness topic without overextending it.

topics.headline: canonical object of enacted work
topics.summary: The noun belongs to the recurrent work-plus-sound-deeds formula and links that work to reward.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the object as a stable Quranic legal-ethical term inside the reward formula.
topics.reason: The supplied recurrence and co-occurrence evidence supports the object as formulaic with the preceding verb and reward field.

topics.headline: qualification closed before result
topics.summary: The object stands immediately before the result particle, completing the condition before recompense is named.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the deed category finish the condition before the reward clause opens.
topics.reason: The local word order places the direct object at the end of the qualifying clause immediately before the result particle.

topics.headline: soundness answers low state
topics.summary: The soundness field counters the low-state verdict and leads into judgment language in the next ayah.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees sound deeds as the semantic opposite of degradation and as the action side of the coming judgment question in 95:7.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete adjacent references, and the bridge is preserved as contextual movement rather than as a local syntactic dependency.

words.gloss_range: result/resumption particle opening the consequence clause after the qualified exception
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the turn from qualification to consequence. It resumes the main reward clause after the long relative description and makes the reward follow from the faith-plus-action condition. Because it fuses directly into the following recipient phrase, consequence and assigned benefit arrive together. The following nominal clause remains compact, with no overt being-verb, so the reward statement feels settled rather than event-like.

topics.headline: result after qualification
topics.summary: The particle both resumes after the relative clause and marks the reward as consequence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the clause move from who qualifies to what follows for them.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the following reward clause as the result for the qualified relative group.

topics.headline: conditional response shape
topics.summary: The particle gives the exception clause a response-like shape without turning the grammar into a full explicit condition.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reward as an entailed result of the described qualification, not as a side note.
topics.reason: The result relation is strongly licensed; the conditional label is retained as constructional resemblance rather than a separate overt condition particle.

topics.headline: consequence fused with possession
topics.summary: The particle attaches to the possessive preposition, compressing result and assigned benefit.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears consequence immediately as something assigned to the qualified group.
topics.reason: The written form fuses the result particle with the prepositional recipient phrase.

topics.headline: compact nominal reward clause
topics.summary: The reward statement uses a compressed nominal clause with an understood existential predicate.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward is stated as a settled possession rather than narrated as a new event.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies an omitted existential predicate in the preposed possessive nominal clause.

words.gloss_range: preposition of possession/benefit in the fronted predicate, governing the attached pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) turns the result into assigned possession and benefit. It governs the attached pronoun in the combined recipient phrase, so the first element of the reward clause is not the reward itself but its recipients. Fronting this prepositional phrase restricts the assignment to the qualified group left standing after the exception. The entitlement force is real, though it should be read as the grammar of possession and benefit rather than a separate claim about obligation outside the clause.

topics.headline: assigned possession and benefit
topics.summary: The preposition marks the reward as for them and belonging to them, while stronger owed-language is kept grammatical rather than theological.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reward as assigned to the qualified group, not merely mentioned near them.
topics.reason: The possessive and benefactive force is licensed by the preposition; claims of being owed are narrowed to entitlement within the result construction.

topics.headline: fronted recipient before reward
topics.summary: The preposed phrase anchors the clause in the recipients before the delayed reward noun appears.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause first says who the reward is for, sharpening the split from the unqualified class.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the prepositional phrase as the preposed predicate for the delayed reward subject.

topics.headline: compact recipient marker
topics.summary: The preposition fuses with the pronoun and compresses benefit, possession, and reference.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the recipient phrase as a small bound unit before the reward is named.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the attached pronoun and forms the visible recipient phrase.

words.gloss_range: attached third masculine plural pronoun referring back to the qualified relative group as reward recipients
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) fixes the recipients of the reward as the already-defined group. Because it is attached inside the combined recipient phrase, the pronoun compresses reference and entitlement into one phrase instead of restarting the sentence with an independent subject. It also completes the boundary movement from humanity under the prior general verdict to a plural qualified subset who receive reward.

topics.headline: recipients tied to the relative group
topics.summary: The pronoun refers back to the relative head and prevents the reward from drifting into a general promise.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader knows exactly who receives the reward: the class just defined by faith and action.
topics.reason: The attachment layer identifies the pronoun's antecedent as the masculine plural relative head.

topics.headline: bound pronoun in entitlement phrase
topics.summary: The attached form makes the recipients inseparable from the prepositional possession phrase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears recipient and assignment as one compact phrase before the reward noun.
topics.reason: The pronoun is governed by the preposition and is not an independent subject pronoun.

topics.headline: humanity resolved into qualified subset
topics.summary: The plural pronoun marks the shift from the prior general human verdict to the rewarded subgroup.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the broad human verdict narrow into the particular plural group that escapes it.
topics.reason: The pronoun's antecedent is the relative class, so the discourse shift from general humanity to qualified recipients is locally supported.

words.gloss_range: indefinite reward/recompense noun, delayed subject after the fronted possessive phrase
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes wage, hire, fee, reward, and recompense; locally the reward sense is shaped by the preceding work and the following non-cut qualifier
words.prose: {{ar:أَجْرٌ}} ({{tr:ajrun}}) names the recompense only after the recipient phrase has been fronted. Grammatically it is the delayed subject of the compact nominal clause, while semantically it answers the work just named. Its maṣdar-like noun form keeps the recompense in an action-result relation. Its indefiniteness leaves the reward unmeasured rather than already identified, and the tanwīn joins the final indefinite cadence that binds the open reward to its uncut qualifier. The root's wage/recompense field makes it feel like a return connected to enacted work without reducing divine reward to a commercial transaction. The following qualifier defines this reward by immunity from severance or reproach, and the phrase also echoes compact reward closures in 84:25 and 41:8.

topics.headline: unmeasured reward
topics.summary: The indefinite noun presents a reward whose magnitude is not delimited.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reward is newly assigned and left open in scale.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as indefinite with tanwīn, and the result clause identifies only the recipients.

topics.headline: reward named after recipients
topics.summary: The reward noun is the delayed subject after the preposed recipient predicate.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears possession assigned before the reward itself is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the preposed possessive phrase and delayed subject in the nominal clause.

topics.headline: wage-like recompense tied to work
topics.summary: The root's wage/recompense field connects reward to the preceding work without excluding divine generosity.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the reward as a return for enacted work, not as a bare label detached from the condition.
topics.reason: The wage/recompense sense is locally supported by the preceding work verb, but claims that would rule out grace are narrowed.

topics.headline: reward defined by its qualifier
topics.summary: The reward noun is paired with the final qualifier that denies severance or reproach.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward not merely named but protected by the phrase that follows.
topics.reason: The adjective and construct evidence ties the reward noun directly to the non-mamnūn qualifier.

topics.headline: recompense linked to faith
topics.summary: The reward field recurs with the faith root and is locally assigned to the class whose first predicate is trust.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reward tied to the whole faith-action identity, not to work language alone.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence evidence links recompense with the faith root, while local syntax assigns it to the full qualified group.

topics.headline: reward replaces low-state scene
topics.summary: The reward noun turns the boundary from the degradation scene toward recompense and echoes reward closures.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the prior low-state outcome answered by a compact reward scene with parallels in 84:25 and 41:8.
topics.reason: The supplied rows give the prior-ayah contrast and concrete parallel references, both preserved as contextual payoff.

topics.headline: indefinite sound thread
topics.summary: The tanwīn of the reward noun joins the final indefinite cadence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the unmeasured reward tied to its uncut qualifier through matching indefinite endings.
topics.reason: The sound observation rests on the local tanwīn in the reward phrase and is kept supportive.

topics.headline: verbal-noun result relation
topics.summary: The noun's maṣdar-like classification keeps recompense connected to action and result.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reward noun carrying an action-result feel after the work predicate.
topics.reason: QAC classifies the word as a gerund/noun, supporting a result relation without changing the local noun sense.

words.gloss_range: nominative construct noun of otherness functioning adjectivally to negate the following passive-participle quality of the reward
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes otherness, difference, change, alteration, exception, and substitution; locally it supplies other-than negation in a construct modifier
words.prose: {{ar:غَيْرُ}} ({{tr:ghayru}}) is not a finite negation particle; it is a noun of otherness functioning as the reward's qualifier. In construct with the final passive participle, it makes the reward other than the state of being cut, diminished, or reproached, nearly defining the reward by that uncut quality. That otherness field gives the phrase more than a simple no: the reward is placed outside the class of things subject to interruption or humiliating reminder. The word also echoes the opening exception logic, since the ayah begins by excluding a group from a verdict and closes by excluding the reward from a denied condition. Its compact reward-seal pattern and nasal binding of negator to qualifier make the close cohere audibly. Its forward bridge to 95:8 is contextual: the stable reward anticipates the final appeal to judgment there.

topics.headline: construct negating modifier
topics.summary: The noun modifies the reward and governs the following passive participle in construct.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees non-severance or non-reproach as a property of the reward itself.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as a nominative qualifier of the reward and as the construct head governing the final word.

topics.headline: description approaching specification
topics.summary: The modifier may be read descriptively or with specifying force, but local grammar keeps it attached to the reward.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase nearly defines the reward by its uncut quality, not merely adds a decorative adjective.
topics.reason: The role evidence allows descriptive or specifying force; it is narrowed to modifier force because the attachment is to the reward noun.

topics.headline: negation through otherness
topics.summary: The root's otherness and alteration field makes the reward categorically outside the denied condition.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reward as belonging to a different category from things that can be cut off or made bitter.
topics.reason: The local lexical unit supports other-than negation, and alteration/change remains a valid root pressure under that selected sense.

topics.headline: nominal negation rather than particle
topics.summary: The abstract noun functions adjectivally and carries negation without a finite negation particle.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that negation is packaged as a substantive category-word.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an abstract noun functioning adjectivally, not as a finite negation particle.

topics.headline: closing exception echo
topics.summary: The word's exception-noun force echoes the opening exception by excluding the reward from a denied category.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah framed by exclusion: the people are excluded from the verdict, and the reward is excluded from severance or reproach.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence allows exception-noun force, while local syntax selects the adjectival construct use.

topics.headline: reward seal anticipates judgment
topics.summary: The non-cut qualifier participates in a recurrent reward seal and points forward to the adjudicative close in 95:8.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward's stability as a closure feature that prepares the final judgment frame in 95:8.
topics.reason: The pair evidence supports the compact reward qualifier, and the forward bridge is limited to the concrete local reference 95:8.

topics.headline: nasal binding of qualifier
topics.summary: The sound texture helps bind the negator and the final denied quality as one closing unit.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the negating construct and final qualifier cohere at the close.
topics.reason: The sound observation is locally tied to the construct phrase and kept as supportive texture.

words.gloss_range: passive participle in genitive construct complement, naming the denied state of being cut off, diminished, or reproached
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes cutting/severing, favor with reproach, strength/sustenance, manna-like provision, measure, and release; locally the passive participle under negation preserves severance and reproach as the denied qualities
words.prose: {{ar:مَمْنُونٍۢ}} ({{tr:mamnūnin}}) is the final word and the denied quality of the reward. As a passive participle governed by the preceding construct head, it leaves unnamed any agent that might cut the reward off, diminish it, or turn it into a reproachful favor. The root's double pressure matters: the reward is neither severed nor made bitter by humiliating reminder. Related provision language, including 2:57, lets the gift field remain audible while the phrase removes the sting of obligation; the fate/death edge of the root family in 52:30 and 68:6 sharpens the denial of severance without controlling the local sense. Its rare passive form and lingering nasal close make the ayah land on permanence and purity before 95:7 turns to judgment/recompense language.

topics.headline: passive denied state
topics.summary: The passive participle is the construct complement and names the condition denied of the reward.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward protected from any unnamed force that could cut it off or make it reproachful.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as a passive participle governed by the preceding construct head.

topics.headline: neither severed nor reproachful
topics.summary: The local participle preserves the root's cutting and favor-reproach pressures as qualities negated of the reward.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the promise as both permanent and free from humiliating obligation.
topics.reason: The V4 and QAC evidence support both severance and reproach senses under the negating construct.

topics.headline: provision field stripped of obligation
topics.summary: The manna/provision branch remains an echo, but local grammar denies reproach rather than naming manna as the sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear gift and sustenance resonances, including 2:57, while recognizing that the local point is reward without reproach.
topics.reason: The provision branch is a valid root-family echo, but the local passive participle in the reward phrase selects the denied reproach/severance state.

topics.headline: fate/death edge sharpens severance
topics.summary: The fate/death branch sharpens the image of severance but does not govern the local reward qualifier.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the reward as immune even to the root family's severing edge noted in 52:30 and 68:6.
topics.reason: The manūn branch is relevant as background severance imagery, but local syntax and sense remain reward not cut off or reproached.

topics.headline: final word carries closure
topics.summary: The ayah ends on the passive participle, giving the denied quality final interpretive weight.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader leaves the ayah with the reward's permanence and purity as the last received meaning.
topics.reason: The word's final position and rare passive-participle profile are locally relevant to the ayah's closure.

topics.headline: nasal lingering supports non-severance
topics.summary: The nasal texture supports the closing sense without proving it independently.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a lingering close that fits the claim that the reward is not cut off.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ءامنوا وعملوا الصالحات, followed by فلهم أجر غير ممنون, joins inward assent, intentional action, soundness, recompense, and a negated limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trusting assent settles the heart and becomes intentional sound-making action; recompense answers that work and is insulated from cutting or diminution.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies the inward commitment that initiates the mechanism.
Intentional doing turns assent into purposive activity.
Soundness against corruption specifies the action as repair rather than bare exertion.
Recompense for work supplies an answering return to the enacted repair.
Otherness and negation exclude the following failure mode from the recompense.
Cutting, diminution, and exhausted continuation name the failure that is negated.

changed_reading.before: A class marked by belief and good deeds receives an endless reward.
changed_reading.after: The exception is a functional chain: settled assent becomes intentional repair, and its answering return remains undiminished rather than merely lasting in the abstract.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عملوا can activate putting something to work, الصالحات can activate fitness for a purpose, and ممنون can activate sustaining strength or its loss.
baseline_models.mechanism: Secure trust provides a stable operating condition in which fitting capacities are put to use; the resulting reward is continuing capacity that does not lose the strength by which it stands.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust provide the stable condition for effective use.
Putting a thing, mind, or material to work supplies the activation step.
Suitability identifies the deployed action or capacity as fitted to its task.
Negation excludes loss from the promised result.
The strength that sustains a thing, or its loss, recasts reward as maintained capacity.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds are a list of approved acts followed by reward.
changed_reading.after: The righteous acts are apt capacities actually put to work, and the reward is a non-depleting power to continue rather than only a later payment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عمل and أجر share a work-and-wage field, while غير ممنون can negate the socially weighty reminder of a favor.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause presents a return answering intentional work but removes the benefactor's power to spoil that return by counting it, reproaching the recipient, or converting it into social leverage.

activation_trace.role: Wage or provision for a worker makes the work-to-return relation explicit.
Recompense, wage, and contractual return supply the deserved-payment pole.
Negation removes a qualifying social burden from the recompense.
A favor made weighty by verbal reminders supplies the burden that is denied.

changed_reading.before: The reward is unending in duration.
changed_reading.after: The reward is also socially unweaponized: it cannot be spoiled by humiliating reminders, moral bookkeeping, or patronal leverage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Edible fruit and expressed oil form a material conversion from grown substance to nourishment and provision. They make intentional sound action in the focus read as productive transformation whose return keeps yielding rather than being consumed.

activation_trace.role: The edible fig supplies a concrete yielded good that can nourish after growth.
Oil as olive extract supplies transformation of a source into a usable yield.
Oil as food, provision, and gift turns the extracted yield into sustained benefit.
Putting something to work links material conversion to the focus action.
Repair and benefit constrain the production image to sound-making use.
Negated cutting or diminution makes the yielded benefit renewable in the model.

structural_cues: 95:1 supplies paired oath nouns without an explicit cultivation or pressing verb, so the production chain is not stated syntax.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edible fig, olive extract, and oil as provision; I infer a growth-to-processing-to-yield arrow that mirrors عمل-to-أجر. A live alternative is that the pair functions only as oath objects or place-signs, without an economic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The recompense is an abstract return that does not end.
changed_reading.after: The recompense behaves like a renewable yield: sound action transforms what is given into nourishment whose benefit is not used up.

context_deltas.mechanism: Successive stages and a boundary that can stop or be crossed shift non-diminution from sheer quantity to phase-transitive continuity: the return remains itself across thresholds rather than terminating at one state.

activation_trace.role: Successive stages supply the temporal sequence across which continuity must hold.
A stopping or crossing boundary supplies the threshold that could otherwise interrupt the return.
Negation excludes boundary-defined termination from the recompense.
Cutting an extension supplies the interruption that phase continuity overcomes.

structural_cues: The mountain noun in 95:2 precedes the later creation, return, exception, and judgment sequence; no explicit syntax equates the mountain with stages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stage succession and a crossable limit; I infer that غير ممنون preserves the return through transitions. The live alternative is the concrete mountain branch, with no phase mechanism intended.

changed_reading.before: Uncut reward means reward of indefinitely large duration.
changed_reading.after: Uncut reward also means continuity that survives changes of state and does not expire at a threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded land qualified by security externalizes the focus root of trust. Intentional dealings and reconciliation can then be read as practices that make a shared place habitable, with the uncut reward appearing as durable civic trust rather than only private compensation.

activation_trace.role: A bounded tract of land supplies the shared spatial container for trust.
Settled security makes the bounded place a trust-bearing environment.
The repeated security root internalizes the city's quality as the believers' settled trust.
Dealing and transaction between people supply the social practice through which trust is exercised.
Reconciliation removes hostility and gives the social dealings a repair function.
Non-interruption lets the social yield persist beyond a single exchange.

structural_cues: 95:3 places the bounded land beside an AMN adjective, while 95:6 reuses AMN as a verb and coordinates it with work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded place, security, social dealings, and reconciliation; I infer that enacted trust produces a secure commons. The live alternative is that the secure-city epithet and individual faith remain parallel but causally unrelated.

changed_reading.before: Belief and good deeds identify individuals who receive private reward.
changed_reading.after: Settled trust enacted through fair dealing and reconciliation makes shared life secure; its durable social habitability is already one form of the uncut return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Complete creation, human sociability, beauty against ugliness, straightness, and sustaining support turn الصالحات into maintenance or restoration of an originally well-set human form. The reward becomes the strength that keeps this alignment standing.

activation_trace.role: Complete and balanced formation supplies the original condition to be maintained or restored.
Companionship that removes estrangement makes the well-set human form relational, not merely anatomical.
Beauty or goodness against ugliness supplies the positive quality of the created form.
Straightness, balance, and evenness supply the geometry of alignment.
Support and subsistence supply what keeps the aligned form standing.
Putting something to work makes human capacities active within the created design.
Making sound against corruption supplies the repair operation.
Sustaining inner strength, with its loss negated, supplies the reward's preserving force.

structural_cues: 95:4 clusters creation, the human, a best-quality term, and تقويم immediately before 95:5's reversal and 95:6's exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complete formation, sociability, beauty, straightness, support, and focus repair; I infer that صالح action re-enacts or restores the created alignment. A live alternative is that 95:4 describes an initial gift while 95:6 lists morally good acts without a maintenance relation.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds satisfy an external moral standard and earn reward.
changed_reading.after: Good deeds are operations that keep or restore the human's well-set, relational form, and the reward is undiminished support for that achieved alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return and active downward motion make the initial إلا a trajectory break. Trust enacted as repair does not merely label an exempt group; it preserves or recovers sound alignment so that descent is not the final functional state and the return is not cut off.

activation_trace.role: Returning something to a place supplies the reversal imposed on the human.
Directed movement downward supplies the adverse trajectory interrupted by the exception.
Trusting assent supplies the stable orientation opposed to disintegration.
Intentional action makes the exception operational rather than nominal.
Repair against corruption supplies the counter-operation to downward return.
Uncut extension names what survives rather than terminating in descent.

structural_cues: 95:5's ثم, object pronoun, and doubled S-F-L expression form the immediate antecedent for 95:6's opening إلا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies imposed return, downward motion, the exception, and repair; I infer a counter-descent causal arrow from enacted trust to preserved alignment. The live alternative is a purely distributive exception in which the acts mark the group but do not themselves resist the trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Believers who do good are simply exempted from a preceding fate.
changed_reading.after: Their trusting repair is the counter-practice by which downward return fails to become final, while an uncut remainder of sound life is preserved.

context_deltas.mechanism: Images of milk disappearing and an animal running then stopping make falsification a failure of duration. The following بعد then tests the focus claim over sequence: assent proves trustworthy by continuing into action, and its reward mirrors that endurance by not cutting out.

activation_trace.role: Milk that goes away and does not last supplies disappearance as a material image of falsification.
A creature that runs and then stops supplies energetic beginning without endurance.
After in relation to before supplies the temporal test across which a claim must persist.
Trusting confirmation supplies the claim whose durability is being tested.
Intentional action is the continuation that prevents assent from being a momentary claim.
Non-interruption makes the reward structurally resemble the enduring assent-and-action sequence.

structural_cues: 95:7 follows the reward clause with فـ, a question, and بعد, placing denial or falsification after the focus sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two K-DH-B images of failed duration plus temporal after; I infer endurance as the test linking assent, action, and uncut return. The live alternative is ordinary propositional denial, with the milk and running images irrelevant to this occurrence.

changed_reading.before: Faith is a confessed proposition, and action is a separate qualification.
changed_reading.after: Faith becomes trustworthy by surviving time as intentional action; a claim that flares and stops falsifies itself, while the answering reward shares the action's continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The account and financial-debt branches of دين activate a ledger around the work-and-wage circuit, but غير ممنون prevents settlement from becoming a new lien of humiliating gratitude. The reward can be accountable without being socially encumbered.

activation_trace.role: Accounting and requital supply the ledger in which action and return are answered.
Financial debt supplies the possible lien or obligation attached to receiving value.
A worker's wage makes the focus return legible within the activated ledger.
Recompense and contractual return supply what the account awards.
Negation removes the attached burden from the awarded return.
Reproachful counting of a favor supplies the social debt that would spoil the award.

structural_cues: The prepositional بالدين closes 95:7's question immediately after 95:6's work-and-recompense clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies account, requital, financial debt, wage, and favor-reminding; I infer that judgment settles rather than perpetuates a lien. The live alternative is دين as judgment or obedience without any financial color, leaving only the duration reading of ممنون.

changed_reading.after: The reward is duly accounted yet leaves no humiliating lien: receipt does not authorize endless reminders or convert recompense into dependency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing negation, judgment, and exactness provide an institutional guarantee for the focus negation. The return is not merely hoped to continue; its freedom from cutoff and patronal spoiling is secured by discriminating judgment.

activation_trace.role: Negation of a present state supplies the rhetorical denial that confirms the closing claim.
Judgment between people supplies the adjudicative setting for recompense.
Exactness, mastery, and secure construction supply reliability to the judgment.
Recompense supplies the object of the adjudicative guarantee.
Negation marks the excluded defect in the judged return.
Cutoff or diminution supplies the defect that exact judgment excludes.
Favor-reminding supplies the social corruption that adjudicated recompense also resists.

structural_cues: 95:8 is a negative interrogative with doubled H-K-M forms, while 95:6 contains its own negating غير before ممنون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negation, adjudication, exactness, and recompense; I infer a court-like guarantee from the final question back to غير ممنون. A live alternative is that the final judgment claim validates the surah generally without specifying the reward's duration or social texture.

changed_reading.before: Non-diminishing reward is an isolated promise.
changed_reading.after: The reward's continuity and freedom from humiliating leverage are verdict-like consequences secured by exact judgment, not a fragile act of patronal generosity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The crookedly knit fracture is a remote branch of the exact focus root for أجر, so it is too surprising to substitute for the ordinary recompense reading. It remains anchored through أجر, صالحات, and the context's straightness image; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary material echo of repair after fracture.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أجر carries a branch of a break knitting crookedly, while صالحات supplies repair and غير ممنون denies the repaired extension's failure.

activation_trace.role: A broken bone knitting crookedly supplies a bodily image hidden inside the recompense root.
Repair against corruption turns the fracture image toward restoration.
Negated cutting or diminution prevents the repaired continuity from failing again.
Straightness and evenness provide the contrast to a crookedly healed seam.

changed_reading.before: أجر names payment for good work.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, the promised return resembles a fracture repaired into enduring alignment, with no renewed break or dwindling at the seam.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading ممنون through its measured-weight branch is less direct than reading it as cut off, but the exact focus form is explicitly included in that branch and the context supplies valuation and accounting. Downstream prose should retain this as an anti-commodification resonance, not replace the temporal reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: غير negates, أجر supplies recompense, and the measured-or-weighed branch explicitly includes ممنون.

activation_trace.role: Recompense supplies the value that might otherwise be priced or quantified.
Negation excludes reduction of the reward to the following metric.
A measured weight, including ممنون for what is measured, supplies the quantification being exceeded.
Valuation and pricing activate the possibility of assigning a finite exchange value.
Accounting and requital supply a legitimate reckoning that need not exhaust value.

changed_reading.before: The reward has no temporal endpoint.
changed_reading.after: The reward can be accounted for without being exhausted by a price, weight, or finite equivalence; judgment recognizes value that commodity measure cannot contain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The stripping image comes from the packet's non-dominant M-R-D mapping of context QAC root R-D-D, making the route unusually branch-distant. It remains valid as an activation because the packet preserves that split and the reading returns to the focus exception and uncut reward; downstream prose must label it as a split-root image, not a lexical gloss of رددناه.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's إلا construction, enacted trust, and غير ممنون can name what remains when the preceding return is activated through an image of stripping away coverings.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped branch supplies stripping a thing of what covers it.
Lowliness in place supplies the exposed destination after stripping.
Trusting assent supplies an inward remainder not reducible to external covering.
Intentional action makes that inward remainder visible and operative.
Non-cut continuation keeps the exposed remainder from being erased.

changed_reading.before: The exception protects a class from being returned low.
changed_reading.after: In the split-root image, return strips away covering and rank; enacted trust is what still operates when exposed, and its return cannot be stripped into nothing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The free-release-without-ransom branch of M-N-N sits under a negated passive form, so its polarity is delicate and cannot yield a straightforward translation. It remains anchored in غير ممنون and coheres with work, recompense, debt, and judgment; downstream prose should phrase it as a legal contrast between recompense and discretionary amnesty.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أجر names recompense while غير ممنون can, at branch distance, deny that the outcome is merely a gratuitous release without compensation.

activation_trace.role: Recompense for work supplies an adjudicated return rather than simple release.
Negation sets the release image in contrast with the promised recompense.
Free release of a captive without ransom supplies the amnesty pole being qualified.
Financial debt supplies the ransom-like exchange from which free release differs.
Judgment supplies the legal frame in which recompense and amnesty are distinct outcomes.

changed_reading.before: The beneficiaries are simply spared and then gifted reward.
changed_reading.after: As a contained legal resonance, their outcome is not mere discretionary amnesty: intentional sound action receives a judged return that cannot be revoked as an optional favor.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Working limbs, bodily stature, and an animal's lower limbs form an odd cross-domain cluster, but each image is branch-backed and the model returns directly to عملوا and the sustaining-strength branch of ممنون. Downstream prose should render it as an embodied analogy, not claim that the verse lexically denotes organs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عملوا can activate a working limb or organ, while غير ممنون can negate loss of the strength by which a bodily operation continues.

activation_trace.role: A working limb or organ makes صالح action an embodied function rather than an abstract score.
Fitness for a task constrains the bodily function to apt coordination.
Sustaining strength or its loss supplies the energy condition of continued function.
Bodily stature and form supply the upright whole coordinated by working parts.
Lower limbs supply the bodily site through which standing can fail or be maintained.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds are detachable moral entries credited to a person.
changed_reading.after: As an embodied analogy, صالح actions are the human's faculties working fitly together to sustain an upright stance whose operative strength does not drain away.

strongest_changes: The focus became a causal chain from settled assent through intentional repair to an answering return protected from cutoff.
Creation and تقويم made صالح action legible as maintenance or restoration of a well-set, relational human form.
The immediate return downward changed إلا from a static class marker into a possible counter-descent mechanism.
دين and حكم made the reward accountable and judicially secured while the favor-reminding branch kept it free of humiliating patronal leverage.
The K-DH-B duration images made enacted endurance, rather than initial profession alone, the test of trustworthy assent.
summary.what_was_special: The same AMN inventory joined an inwardly settled heart to a secure bounded place, while غير ممنون sustained several coexisting negations: no cutoff, no depletion of strength, no weaponized reminder, and, more experimentally, no exhaustive weighing or merely discretionary amnesty.
remaining_uncertainties: The cutoff branch of M-N-N is the cleanest syntactic fit, but favor-reminding, sustaining strength, measured weight, and free release remain live secondary activations rather than resolved alternatives.
The fruit, oil, stage, and civic mechanisms may be functional activators or may remain only oath objects, place-images, and parallel root echoes.
The claim that enacted repair causally resists downward return is reader-supplied; the syntax also permits a distributive exception without that causal arrow.
The stripping reading depends on the packet's non-dominant R-D-D to M-R-D mapping and therefore requires explicit split-root containment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Exception as restored trust plus intentional repair.** Lexical evidence: ء م ن B002, trusting assent/confirmation; ع م ل B001, intentional doing; ص ل ح B001, soundness/rightness against corruption; ص ل ح B002, reconciliation. Structural cue: إلا marks an escape from the return to the lowest, and the exception combines inner assent with outward work. Assigned role: faith stabilizes the heart; work performs repair; ṣāliḥāt are not merely "good deeds" but acts that make sound what could corrupt. Abductive move: I infer that the exception reverses 95:5 by repairing the defect that caused descent. Reading change: the ayah reads as a mechanism of restoration from lowliness, not just a category label for believers.

2. **The secure city becomes an inward social order.** Lexical evidence: ء م ن B001 in 95:3, settled security/trust; ء م ن B002 here, assent; ب ل د B001/د ي ن B006, bounded city/ordered authority; ص ل ح B002, reconciliation among people. Structural cue: the root ء م ن links "secure town" to "those who believed." Assigned role: the social environment of security is internalized by believers and externalized through reconciliatory works. Abductive move: I infer that the packet uses place-security as a template for communal-ethical repair. Reading change: belief is not merely private assent; it participates in making a secure/reconciled order.

3. **A wage-contract circuit after accountable work.** Lexical evidence: ع م ل B001/B004, work and wage/pay; ء ج ر B001, recompense, wage, hire, reward; د ي ن B002/B003 in 95:7, reckoning/recompense and debt; ح ك م B002 in 95:8, adjudication. Structural cue: عملوا is immediately followed by أجر, then 95:7-8 asks about الدين and the judge. Assigned role: the ayah forms a contractual/judicial chain: work creates an owed return, and the final judge guarantees it. Abductive move: I infer that أجر is not only gift but a just return within a judgment economy. Reading change: "reward" becomes adjudicated compensation for actual work, not arbitrary favor.

4. **Uncut, unweakened reward resists the whole downward/cutting field.** Lexical evidence: م ن ن B001, cutting off/diminishing extension; م ن ن B002, strength that sustains or its loss; م ن ن B003, favor that can be ruined by reminding; غ ي ر B005, otherness/negation. Structural cue: غير ممنون follows أجر after the fall of 95:5. Assigned role: غير negates the branch of cutting/diminution; ممنون supplies both "cut off" and favor-burden possibilities. Abductive move: I infer that the reward's continuity answers the interrupted descent: what was returned downward does not cut off the excepted person's recompense. Reading change: "unfailing reward" becomes an anti-collapse promise—uncut, undiminished, and not spoiled by humiliating reminder.

5. **Substitution/compensation rather than retaliation.** Lexical evidence: غ ي ر B002, legal compensation as alternative to retaliation; غ ي ر B003, substitution/change; ء ج ر B001, recompense; ح ك م B002, legal assessment. Structural cue: the phrase غير ممنون is placed in a legal-reward context before الدين/حكم. Assigned role: غير can mark not only negation but a replacement economy: a measured recompense substitutes for the trajectory of lowliness. Abductive move: I infer a legal settlement mechanism from compensation, wage, reckoning, and judge branches. Reading change: the ayah can read as a mercifully adjudicated alternative to mere degradation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 95:7-8 made the reward phrase more juridical than devotional. دين B002/B003 and حكم B002 turned أجر into a judged wage/debt circuit, while ح ك م B001 made صالحات look like repair that restrains corruption. The phrase غير ممنون also gained force from the earlier fall: what descends, exhausts, or is cut off is answered by a reward explicitly not cut off. The later ayat therefore pushed the exception from "pious group" toward "restored legal standing."

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Trust as a stabilizing counter-state.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ء م ن/B002` supplies trusting assent and confirmation. The same root in 95:3 uses `ء م ن/B001` for safety, trust, and the trustworthy. **Structural cue:** the trustworthy city precedes the human’s downward return, and the verb *āmanū* is the first marker inside the exception to that return. **Assigned role:** settled civic trust is the external model; believing is its enacted inward counterpart. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies root recurrence and exception syntax but not the causal arrow; I infer trusting assent → stabilization against descent. **Reading change:** faith reads as a mode of becoming secure and reliable, not merely accepting a proposition.

2. **Sound deeds as maintenance or repair of formation.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ع م ل/B001` supplies intentional action, while fixed `ص ل ح/B001` supplies soundness and setting right against corruption. Earlier `خ ل ق/B003` supplies complete balanced form and `ق و م/B008` straightness; 95:5 supplies their downward inversion. **Structural cue:** assent is coordinated with intentional sound acts inside the exception. **Assigned role:** action is the operative means and *ṣalāḥ* the repaired or maintained condition. **Abductive move:** the packet does not say deeds mechanically restore form; I infer initial calibration → threatened corruption → corrective maintenance from the sequence. **Reading change:** “worked the sound deeds” becomes functional upkeep of the human’s best setting, not an unspecified list of merits.

3. **Social reconciliation within the sound deeds.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ص ل ح/B002` supplies reconciliation and removal of hostility between people. It is activated by the trustworthy city of 95:3 and later `ح ك م/B002`, adjudication among people (95:8). **Structural cue:** the exception lies inside a surah framed by civic security and judgment, not only private formation. **Assigned role:** the plural *ṣāliḥāt* includes acts that repair relations and make common order possible. **Abductive move:** the packet does not enumerate any deed; I infer that the accepted reconciliation branch becomes salient because social trust and adjudication flank the verse. **Reading change:** righteous action acquires a concrete peace-making function alongside personal rectitude.

4. **A work-to-wage contract whose yield does not expire.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ع م ل/B004` supplies the worker’s wage, fixed `ء ج ر/B001` recompense for work or a contract-like exchange, and fixed `م ن ن/B001` cutting off or diminishing an extension. **Structural cue:** “they worked” is followed by causal/resultative *fa-lahum* and then “a recompense not cut or diminished.” **Assigned role:** work establishes the service side, *ajr* the due return, and negated *mann* its uninterrupted duration. **Abductive move:** here the packet supplies both lexical exchange and a grammatical result marker; I infer deed → due recompense, while its endlessness exceeds an ordinary finite wage. **Reading change:** the ayah reads as a precise labor-and-return mechanism rather than a loose promise following belief.

5. **Reward not rationed by measure.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `م ن ن/B005` allows *mamnūn* for what is measured or weighed, while fixed `غ ي ر/B005` supplies otherness and negation. Earlier `ق و م/B010` and `ق و م/B015` supply valuation and exact weight; later `د ي ن/B002` and `ح ك م/B002` supply reckoning and judgment. **Structural cue:** *ghayru mamnūn* directly qualifies *ajr* after the work clause. **Assigned role:** judgment establishes value, but *ghayr* cancels finite metering of the resulting reward. **Abductive move:** the packet does not state a quantity; I infer assessed worth without rationing from appraisal → recompense → “not measured.” **Reading change:** a distinct reading emerges beside “uncut”: the recompense is not doled out under a limiting scale.

6. **A favor without reproach or leverage.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `م ن ن/B003` includes benefaction but also the human act of burdening a recipient by rehearsing a favor; fixed `غ ي ر/B005` negates the qualified image. **Structural cue:** the phrase denies *mamnūn* immediately after assigning the reward “to them.” **Assigned role:** *ajr* remains a benefaction, while *ghayr* excludes the speech-act that turns a gift into humiliation or obligation. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies both positive favor and blameworthy reminder within one branch; I infer that negation targets the coercive variant while leaving benefaction intact. **Reading change:** the reward is not only continuous but dignifying: it does not place recipients under the social weight of being reminded what they owe.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 95:7’s `د ي ن/B002` and 95:8’s `ح ك م/B002` retrospectively placed the reward inside an accounting-and-adjudication mechanism. That sharpened two distinctions in 95:6: *ghayru mamnūn* can deny finite measurement (`م ن ن/B005`) even though deeds are assessed, and social reconciliation (`ص ل ح/B002`) belongs naturally within deeds judged in a civic frame.

baseline.text: Ancak inanıp iyi işler yapanlar için kesintisiz bir ödül vardır.

findings.text: İnanmak, güvenli şehirde dışarıdan görülen güvenilirliği insanın içinde yerleşik bir güven ve doğrulamaya dönüştürerek düşüşe karşı denge kurar.
İyi işler, bozulmuş olanı yeniden sağlamlaştıran ve doğru yapıyı koruyan amaçlı onarım eylemleri olarak belirginleşir.
İyilik, insanlar arasındaki düşmanlığı gideren uzlaşmayı da kapsar; böylece kişisel doğruluk toplumsal barışa açılır.
İş ile ödülün yan yana gelişi, yapılan emeğin hakkını adil hesap ve hükümle teslim eden bir ücret ilişkisi kurar.
Ödül yalnız kesilmeyen değil, gücü eksilmeyen bir karşılıktır.
Ödül, ölçülüp sınırlı paylara bölünmeyen bir bolluk olarak da okunabilir.
Ödül bir iyilik olduğu hâlde, alıcıya sürekli hatırlatılıp onu minnet altında bırakan bir baskıya dönüşmez.
Karşılığın değiştirme ve hukuki tazmin anlamları, aşağılanma yolunun yerine ölçülü bir telafi düzeni geçirildiği ihtimalini açar.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **95:6.** إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ — Birincil okuma: İman edip salih işler yapanlar, aşağı çevrilme hattından ayrılan istisna topluluğudur ve onlara kesintisiz bir ecir vardır. Sonraki din ve hüküm sorusu, bu ecri yalnız lütuf değil, güven, onarım, emek, karşılık ve kesilmeyen hukuki/ahlaki teminat düzeni olarak derinleştirir. {ء م ن B002; ع م ل B001; ص ل ح B001; ص ل ح B002; ء ج ر B001; غ ي ر B005; م ن ن B001; م ن ن B003}

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A defective or absent function is restored by activation, compatible replacement, restraint, or exact repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation and good action open into a technical scene of operating parts, substituting equivalents, arresting failure, and securing a finished repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Making and Activating
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A thing is manufactured, put into operation, and taken up as an active task.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: manufacture from material `خ ل ق:B002/m02`, operation and application `ع م ل:B002/m01`, rising to undertake an affair `ق و م:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Manufacture provides the object, application makes it operative, and rising to the affair supplies the active operator. Together they form a compact production-to-use sequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A defective or absent function is restored by activation, compatible replacement, restraint, or exact repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation and good action open into a technical scene of operating parts, substituting equivalents, arresting failure, and securing a finished repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Compatible Replacement and Restoration
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: One item stands in for another, fits its intended place, and restores the prior arrangement without delay.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: standing in another's place `ق و م:B007/m01`, replacement by another `غ ي ر:B003/m01`, return to owner or place `ر د د:B001/m02`, functional suitability `ص ل ح:B003/m01`, enactment without delay `ك ذ ب:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Substitution is not mere exchange: the replacement must fit the vacant function and be returned into the operative position. Immediacy closes the mechanism by preventing the restored function from remaining suspended.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A defective or absent function is restored by activation, compatible replacement, restraint, or exact repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation and good action open into a technical scene of operating parts, substituting equivalents, arresting failure, and securing a finished repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Restraint, Repulsion, and Repair
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Harm or corruption is stopped, pushed away, and replaced with a sound condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: restraint against corruption `ح ك م:B001/m01`, repulsion and prevention `ر د د:B002/m01`, repair after فساد `ص ل ح:B001/m02`, corrective substitution `غ ي ر:B003/m02`, repair of equipment `غ ي ر:B001/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Restraint blocks the damaging motion, repulsion removes it from its course, and repair reinstates sound operation. Corrective substitution supplies the practical means by which the harmful state is exchanged for a serviceable one.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A defective or absent function is restored by activation, compatible replacement, restraint, or exact repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation and good action open into a technical scene of operating parts, substituting equivalents, arresting failure, and securing a finished repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Exact and Beneficial Finish
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Work is completed with precision until it is secure, sound, and beneficial.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: exact workmanship `ح س ن:B002/m02`, secure finishing `ح ك م:B004/m01`, sound integrity `ص ل ح:B001/m01`, beneficial maintenance `غ ي ر:B001/m01`, fracture mended on a bend `ء ج ر:B002/m01`, absence of useful result `ب ع د:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Exact execution leads to a tightly secured and useful result. A fracture that heals crooked and an outcome with no benefit supply the contrary finish, distinguishing mere completion from sound, effective completion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Claims, conduct, and obligations are entrusted to an authority that distinguishes truth, assigns judgment, and brings a final account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Final judgment reaches into arbitration, testimony, counterfeit rejection, fabricated speech, and the contrast between penetrating and weak counsel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Delegated Judgment and Credited Testimony
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person is trusted, authorized to decide, and either credited or charged with falsehood.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: delegated arbitration `ح ك م:B005/m01`, crediting testimony or oath `د ي ن:B007/m01`, assent and belief `ء م ن:B002/m01`, attribution of falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Trust grants standing to a witness or arbiter, delegated judgment gives that standing practical force, and attribution of truth or falsehood determines whether the entrusted word remains authoritative.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Deliberate labor enters relations of wage, debt, valuation, restitution, livelihood, and release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The unending reward scene expands into labor markets, credit, pricing, equal weights, rescission, public office, bondage, and release without ransom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Work and Uncut Wage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Deliberate good work earns a wage whose duration is not cut off.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: intentional work `ع م ل:B001/m01`, wage and recompense `ء ج ر:B001/m01`, worker's pay `ع م ل:B004/m01`, uncut duration `م ن ن:B001/m01`, sound deed `ص ل ح:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Intentional action supplies the labor, soundness qualifies the deed, and wage names the return. The cutting sense of `م ن ن` defines the reward negatively as a payment whose extension is not severed or diminished.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Deliberate labor enters relations of wage, debt, valuation, restitution, livelihood, and release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The unending reward scene expands into labor markets, credit, pricing, equal weights, rescission, public office, bondage, and release without ransom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Debt, Dealing, and Rescission
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Parties enter a deferred obligation, transact with one another, settle conflict, and may reclaim or unwind the exchange.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: debt and credit sale `د ي ن:B003/m01`, interpersonal dealing `ع م ل:B005/m01`, repossession and rescission `ر د د:B004/m01`, negotiated settlement `ص ل ح:B002/m01`, assessed compensation `ح ك م:B002/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Debt creates the continuing obligation, dealing establishes the relation between parties, and settlement governs disagreement within it. Rescission and assessed compensation provide two different closures: reversing the transaction or fixing what one party owes.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Deliberate labor enters relations of wage, debt, valuation, restitution, livelihood, and release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The unending reward scene expands into labor markets, credit, pricing, equal weights, rescission, public office, bondage, and release without ransom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Valuation and Equal Weight
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Goods or liabilities are priced, weighed to an even standard, and converted into quantified compensation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: pricing and valuation `ق و م:B010/m01`, equal coin weight `ق و م:B015/m01`, measured quantity `م ن ن:B005/m01`, blood-money compensation `غ ي ر:B002/m01`, circulating market demand `ق و م:B018/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Valuation assigns an amount, equal weight stabilizes the unit, and measured quantity makes the amount transferable. Market circulation gives the unit an arena of exchange, while blood money extends quantified substitution from commodities to retaliation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Deliberate labor enters relations of wage, debt, valuation, restitution, livelihood, and release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The unending reward scene expands into labor markets, credit, pricing, equal weights, rescission, public office, bondage, and release without ransom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Labor, Office, and Livelihood
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Workers perform manual or appointed service and receive the means by which life and social order are maintained.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: appointed public work `ع م ل:B003/m01`, manual workers `ع م ل:B006/m01`, livelihood and subsistence `ق و م:B009/m02`, wage `ء ج ر:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Manual labor and appointed office are two organized forms of service. Wage converts that service into livelihood, while the support sense of `ق و م` makes livelihood what keeps both body and social arrangement standing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Deliberate labor enters relations of wage, debt, valuation, restitution, livelihood, and release.
